milestones.name: Scaffold Package
milestones.goal: Create the package skeleton with __init__, CLI entry point, requirements.txt and a passing scaffold test. This establishes a runnable module and test harness.

milestones.name: Oracle Core
milestones.goal: Implement the Oracle that loads historical market data, advances the simulation clock, releases time‑appropriate information, and records forecasts and outcomes while enforcing the strict information firewall.

milestones.name: Portfolio Accounting & Risk Manager
milestones.goal: Provide accurate cash, holdings, P&L accounting and enforce default risk limits (position size, sector exposure, no leverage/shorts).

milestones.name: Trading Decision Engine
milestones.goal: Define the decision workflow: forecast generation, order creation, locking, realistic execution, and outcome revelation. Connect Oracle, Trader, and Accounting.

milestones.name: Self‑Discovering Strategy Engine
milestones.goal: Allow the Trader to generate, version, experiment, and promote strategies based on hypotheses, with full experiment logging and challenger‑champion handling.

milestones.name: Weekly Grading System
milestones.goal: Compute a weekly grade based on portfolio performance, risk‑adjusted returns, and benchmark comparison. Provide survival feedback to the Trader.

milestones.name: Market Regime Detector & Relationship Map
milestones.goal: Detect market regimes (bull, bear, sideways) and build a relationship discovery map of asset correlations and sector linkages for use in strategy hypotheses.

milestones.name: Counterfactual Investigator & Prediction Calibration
milestones.goal: Implement tools to run counterfactual analyses of past decisions and calibrate prediction probabilities against realized outcomes.

milestones.name: Adversarial Auditor & Firewall Tests
milestones.goal: Create an Auditor that attempts to breach the information firewall, validates that no future data leaks to the Trader, and flags violations.

milestones.name: Live Paper‑Trading Transition & Integration
milestones.goal: Add a minimal live‑paper‑trading mode, integrate all components, provide a README with usage instructions, and a full‑system integration test.
